steps.message: The build succeeds. Let me review the final state of the patched dialogs:

## Diagnosis

The defect was in `ComposeActivity.java`'s back-press confirmation dialog. It assigned the **confirming/destructive action** ("Discard") to the *negative* button and the **dismissive action** ("Cancel") to the *positive* button. Since Material's dialog button bar lays buttons out as `neutral | negative | positive` (left → right), this rendered "Discard" on the left and "Cancel" on the right — exactly the arrangement Material guidelines call out as a "Don't" (the confirming action must always be rightmost, the dismissive action to its left).

## Changes

**`ComposeActivity.java`** — Discard dialog (the reported bug): swapped the roles so `Cancel` is the negative (left) button and `Discard` is the positive (right) button, carrying the `dialog.cancel(); finish();` handler with it. Behavior is unchanged — only the placement is corrected.

I then audited every other dialog in the app for the same class of issue:

| Dialog | Buttons | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `ComposeActivity` formatting info | "Dismiss" as negative | → positive |
| `MainActivity` changelog | neutral "GitHub" + "Done" as negative | "Done" → positive |
| `UserActions` failure detail | "Done" as negative | → positive |
| `LoginDialogFragment` (custom layout) | cancel `layout_toLeftOf` save | already correct, untouched |
| `UserDialogFragment`, `CommentsSearchDialogFragment`, `DialogUtils` text selection, comment-action list | no confirming/dismissive pair | untouched |

The three acknowledgement dialogs used `setNegativeButton` for what is semantically a confirming action. They render in the same spot either way (a lone button is end-aligned), so these edits are visually neutral but make the button semantics consistent with the guidelines, addressing the report's "other dialogs should be checked" note without altering any behavior.

`./gradlew clean assembleDebug` → **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**.
